packageRules.description: Gate katex major updates behind Dependency Dashboard approval. rehype-katex@7 and micromark-extension-math@3 both depend on katex ^0.16.0, so bumping the root dep only swaps the stylesheet while 0.16 still renders the markup. KaTeX 0.18 changed its CSS classes, so the two drift apart and the build's rendering check fails (see #277). Approve this only in a PR that also moves rehype-katex/remark-math to releases supporting the new KaTeX.
